stories.title: The Ocean That Lives Without Sunlight
stories.description: Life thriving in total darkness deep beneath the ocean.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic deep ocean abyss, complete darkness, faint blue bioluminescent glow, slow drifting particles suspended in water, subtle light shimmer, atmospheric motion, vertical 9:16
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, cartoon, low quality, blurry
scenes.narration: Did you know there are ecosystems on Earth that survive without sunlight?

scenes.visual_prompt: Hydrothermal vents on ocean floor releasing glowing mineral-rich steam, gentle plume movement, shimmering heat distortion in water, floating particles, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16
scenes.narration: Deep beneath the ocean, life exists without the sun, powered by heat from the Earth itself.

scenes.visual_prompt: Deep-sea creatures silhouetted near glowing vents, slow graceful drifting motion, soft light flicker, underwater haze gently moving, cinematic realism
scenes.narration: These creatures survive using energy from chemicals, not sunlight.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide view of vast dark ocean floor, glowing vents pulsing faintly, particles slowly sinking and drifting, subtle cinematic camera drift into darkness
scenes.narration: Life always finds a way, even in total darkness.

stories.title: The Day the Earth Almost Froze
stories.description: When Earth became a frozen snowball.

scenes.visual_prompt: Planet Earth completely covered in ice seen from space, slow planetary rotation, soft light moving across frozen surface, cinematic realism, vertical 9:16
scenes.narration: Did you know Earth was once completely frozen from pole to pole?

scenes.visual_prompt: Endless glaciers stretching across the planet, icy winds blowing fine snow across surface, drifting ice fog, subtle atmospheric movement
scenes.narration: Scientists call this period Snowball Earth.

scenes.visual_prompt: Small pockets of liquid water beneath thick ice sheets, faint light rippling through ice layers, slow moving bubbles, cinematic macro atmosphere
scenes.narration: Life barely survived beneath the ice, waiting for warmth to return.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ice sheets slowly cracking and melting, sunlight gradually spreading, mist rising gently from thawing ice, hopeful cinematic motion
scenes.narration: And when the ice melted, life reshaped the planet once again.

stories.title: The Invisible Shield Around Earth
stories.description: Earth’s hidden force field that protects all life.

scenes.visual_prompt: Earth floating in space surrounded by glowing magnetic field lines, energy lines slowly flowing and bending, subtle orbital camera drift, deep blue tones
scenes.narration: Did you know Earth is protected by an invisible force field?

scenes.visual_prompt: Solar storm particles streaming toward Earth and curving away around magnetic field, flowing particle motion, cinematic space atmosphere
scenes.narration: This shield deflects deadly radiation from the sun.

scenes.visual_prompt: Aurora borealis slowly rippling across polar night sky, smooth flowing light waves, stars subtly shifting, cinematic night atmosphere
scenes.narration: The auroras are visible proof of this protection.

scenes.visual_prompt: Earth rotating peacefully in space, clouds slowly moving over surface, calm cinematic camera drift outward
scenes.narration: Without it, life on Earth would not exist.

stories.title: The Ice That Remembers the Past
stories.description: Ice holding Earth’s ancient climate secrets.

scenes.visual_prompt: Massive Antarctic ice sheets under cold blue light, drifting snow particles, slow aerial glide, endless frozen horizon
scenes.narration: Did you know ice can remember Earth’s climate from a million years ago?

scenes.visual_prompt: Macro view of ice core with trapped air bubbles, bubbles slowly shifting, light refracting through ice layers, cinematic texture detail
scenes.narration: Tiny air bubbles trapped in ice are time capsules from the past.

scenes.visual_prompt: Scientists drilling deep ice cores in polar landscape, drifting ice fog, subtle camera movement across frozen terrain
scenes.narration: Scientists study them to understand how our planet has changed.

scenes.visual_prompt: Endless frozen horizon fading into distance, gentle snowfall, soft light changes, quiet cinematic motion
scenes.narration: The ice remembers what the Earth once was.

stories.title: The River Beneath the Amazon
stories.description: A hidden river flowing deep underground.

scenes.visual_prompt: Aerial view of Amazon rainforest canopy, clouds slowly drifting overhead, river gently flowing below, cinematic daylight
scenes.narration: Did you know there’s a river flowing beneath the Amazon River?

scenes.visual_prompt: Smooth transition from surface river into underground layers, soil and rock subtly shifting, water glow moving downward
scenes.narration: Deep underground flows a massive hidden river.

scenes.visual_prompt: Underground water channels flowing slowly through rock layers, light shimmering through water, suspended particles drifting
scenes.narration: It moves silently beneath the forest, unseen by the world above.

scenes.visual_prompt: Amazon River at sunset, slow flowing water reflecting sky, mist rising gently from surface, calm cinematic drift
scenes.narration: Some of Earth’s greatest wonders are hidden from sight.
